column2:
Conduct a SWOT analysis for my business.
Here's my context:
- My business: [describe in 2-3 sentences]
- Revenue: [approximate range]
- Team size: [just me / X people]
- Time in business: [how long]
- Key offerings: [list]
- Biggest win recently: [describe]
- Biggest challenge right now: [describe]
For each quadrant (Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats), identify at least 5 items. Don't just list them — for each one, include a brief explanation of WHY it's a strength/weakness/opportunity/threat and a SPECIFIC action I can take because of it. End with a prioritized action plan: the top 3 things I should focus on based on this analysis.
